statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail 9% (low), Stress 48% (elevated), Confidence 89% (high), dominant mode mixed. The 30,957.50 session low was retested at 30,960.00 in the 10:35Z bar and held, and NQZ26 then rallied 87 points to 31,046.75 by 10:55Z, the morning's first higher high, although the 31,061.75 prior close was not reclaimed.
recommendation: Tail at 9% is well below the 25% block threshold, so the deterministic mapping yields EA_ON and green for both NQ futures and the NAS100 CFD. The narrow evidence-based danger window spans 13:00Z to 15:00Z, covering the 13:30Z US cash open, the 13:45Z S&P Global September PMI finals and the 14:00Z September ISM Services release, where the published path peaks at 17% and remains inside the low band. Stress at 48% stays elevated and describes a difficult but recoverable environment under a multi-decade-high yield regime; it does not alter the Tail-derived mapping.
headline: Tail falls to 9% as the 30,957.50 session low was retested at 30,960.00 and held, with NQZ26 rallying 87 points to 31,046.75 by 10:55Z for the morning's first higher high, last 31,010.50 and 0.17% below the prior close
body:
The prior hour published Tail at 14% on repeated extension after a failed retracement, and named the invalidation precisely: sustained trade below 30,957.50 on shallow or failed pullbacks. The opposite happened. NQZ26 sold back into the low in the 10:30Z and 10:35Z bars, printed 30,962.00 and then 30,960.00, and stopped two and a half points above the 09:40Z session low. That is a successful retest, not a second leg.

What followed is the clearest mean-reversion evidence of the overnight. From 30,960.00 the index rallied to 31,019.75 by 10:50Z and 31,046.75 by 10:55Z, an 86.75-point advance in twenty minutes that broke above the 31,002.00 ceiling of the 10:00Z hour. That is the first higher high since the 31,221.25 print in the 01:00Z hour, and it interrupts the nine-hour sequence of lower highs and lower lows that had been the main Tail amplifier. The rally then stalled 15 points short of the 31,061.75 prior close, pulled back to 30,986.00 inside the 11:00Z hour, and recovered again to 31,025.00 by 11:15Z, with the last print 31,010.50 at 11:18:34Z. The 11:00Z hour has traded a roughly 46-point band, wider than the 25-point coil of the 10:00Z hour but two-way rather than directional.

The absolute move remains small. At 31,010.50 the index is 51.25 points, or 0.17%, below Friday's close, and 210.75 points below the overnight high. ES at 7,770.00 is 0.09% lower against a 7,777.25 prior close, so Nasdaq still underperforms the broad index slightly, but both have recovered off their lows together.

Cross-asset alignment has weakened materially, and that is the second reason Tail falls. The bond market was the dominant amplifier: the 10-year closed Friday near 5.28% after an intraday 5.342%, its highest since 2002, and the 30-year reached 5.63%. Today the 10-year is quoted at 5.27%, roughly a basis point lower, with the 2-year at 4.82% and down 2 basis points. Official H.15 data for 1 October carried the 2-year at 4.78%, the 10-year at 5.24% and the 30-year at 5.61%. A stabilising rather than extending yield path removes the aligned-amplifier condition the risk contract requires for Tail above 25%. VIX at 16.23 is 6.01% firmer than its 15.31 close but inside a narrow 16.07 to 16.38 range from a low absolute base. The dollar index is 0.31% higher at 102.246. Gold at 4,190.20 is 0.67% firmer, a mild bid rather than a flight to quality. WTI is 0.92% lower at 90.27 while Brent at 102.46 is marginally higher, leaving a Brent-WTI spread above 12 dollars that reflects a seaborne Strait of Hormuz risk premium; reporting today that Hormuz crude flows have returned above pre-war levels argues against fresh escalation transmission.

Tail at 9% reflects a retested and held session low, a genuine 87-point retracement, a failed but orderly reclaim attempt, and the loss of the aligned yield amplifier, set against a residual shallow downtrend and a high-impact release still ahead. Stress eases three points to 48% because the yield regime remains at multi-decade highs and the September ISM Services release is still to come, but today's bond stabilisation reduces the environment's severity. Confidence rises two points to 89% on a complete live five-minute NQ path through 11:18:34Z, live cross-asset quotes through 11:19Z, a live 2-year, 10-year and 30-year read for today, official H.15 figures and a verified seven-day calendar. It is held below 90% because the shared Finviz context is about five and a half days stale and marked partial, so breadth, megacap and semiconductor confirmation is genuinely unavailable this run.

lookbackSummary: Twenty-three of the 24 preceding published hours are available from Claude history. The 06:00Z slot on 5 October is explicitly unavailable because no assessment was published inside that clock-hour; its fields are null rather than interpolated. Tail was pinned at 3% from 11:00Z through 21:00Z on 4 October while the CME equity-index complex was halted for the weekend and no Nasdaq-100 price path was scoreable, with Stress in the 64-71% band on the standing yield regime. Tail then rose through the Sunday reopen as the overnight drift extended, reaching 12% at 22:00Z and peaking at 15% at 01:00Z on 5 October. It decayed to 8% by 04:00Z as the drift stayed orderly, bottomed at 6% at 08:00Z when the 31,061.75 prior close was briefly reclaimed, then rose to 11% at 09:00Z once that reclaim failed and to 14% at 10:00Z on the extension to a new session low. Every available hour mapped to EA_ON and green. Past opinions are preserved exactly as published and are not restated with hindsight.
outlookSummary: The invalidation named by the prior hour did not trigger. The 30,957.50 session low was retested at 30,960.00 in the 10:35Z bar and held, and NQZ26 then rallied 86.75 points to 31,046.75 by 10:55Z, the first higher high since the 01:00Z hour, before stalling 15 points short of the 31,061.75 prior close. Tail therefore falls from 14% to 9%, helped by a 10-year quoted at 5.27% today rather than extending through Friday's 5.342% high. The published path holds 9% through the European session, lifts to 13% as the 13:00Z-15:00Z danger window opens around the 13:30Z cash open and the 13:45Z S&P Global PMI finals, and peaks at 17% for the 14:00Z September ISM Services release. That peak stays inside the low band and inside EA_ON because event importance raises Stress and lowers Confidence before it raises Tail. The path then decays to 13% by 16:00Z on the assumption of orderly post-release discovery, holds 10-11% through the US afternoon and power hour, and settles at 8-11% across the futures-only and Asian sessions, with Confidence falling from 89% to a 54% horizon floor at the 23-hour limit. The invalidation for the whole path is sustained trade below 30,957.50 on shallow or failed pullbacks; the upside neutraliser is a durable reclaim of 31,061.75.
